image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene depicting the climax of a race where three pterosaurs approach a floating finish line, with a clear winner established.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Blue and yellow, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING PTEROSAURS!' located at the top of the image.

assets.name: Victory Text
assets.description: Bold, celebratory 3D block text reading 'PLAYER WINS!' located at the bottom of the image, styled to match the header.

assets.name: Winning Pterosaur (Quetzalcoatlus)
assets.description: The gigantic, slender Quetzalcoatlus in a full-speed flight pose, neck extended forward, clearly ahead of the others and inches away from the finish sash.

assets.name: Trailing Racer 1 (Tupandactylus)
assets.description: The colorful Tupandactylus in mid-air behind the leader, wings flapping vigorously with a determined expression.

assets.name: Trailing Racer 2 (Cearadactylus)
assets.description: The compact Cearadactylus flying on the opposite side of the leader, showing visible effort to catch up.

assets.name: Floating Finish Line Sash
assets.description: A vibrant red checkered finish line sash stretched horizontally across the air, held aloft by several large, colorful 3D balloons attached to each end.

assets.name: Djadokhta Aerial Environment
assets.description: A high-altitude view of the Djadokhta canyon with its signature flame-orange and sunset-red sandstone walls visible below.

assets.name: Atmospheric Perspective
assets.description: Motion blur streaks behind the pterosaurs to emphasize speed, with a slight hazy glow in the distant horizon as per the SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC lighting preset.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent lens-flare type logo/watermark located in the bottom-right corner.
